MIGRATION.TITLE: Migrate legacy documents
MIGRATION.DESCRIPTION: Import legacy organization documents and help center articles into the Documents hub
MIGRATION.SOURCES_REQUIRED: Pick at least one legacy source.
MIGRATION.DRY_RUN_HINT: A dry run reads the legacy data and reports exactly what an import would create. Nothing is written until you run the import.
MIGRATION.DRY_RUN_REQUIRED: Run a dry run before importing.
MIGRATION.DRY_RUN_STALE: The selected sources changed — run the dry run again before importing.
MIGRATION.RUN_CONFIRM: Import {{ count }} documents into the Documents hub?
MIGRATION.RUN_CONFIRM_NOTE: Documents are created, never overwritten: legacy records that were already imported are skipped, and the legacy Organization Documents and Help Center data is left untouched.
MIGRATION.ERROR_IN_PROGRESS: A migration is already running for this organization. Try again in a few moments.
MIGRATION.ERROR_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to run this migration.
MIGRATION.ERROR_FAILED: The migration request failed — run a dry run to see what is already imported.

REPORT.NOTHING_TO_IMPORT: The selected legacy sources hold nothing to import.

ACTIONS.SKIPPED_DELETED: Skipped — deleted after a previous import

WARNINGS.DUPLICATE_NAME_SUFFIXED: Renamed to keep sibling names unique
WARNINGS.EMPTY_CONTENT: The legacy record had no content
WARNINGS.ORPHANED_CATEGORY: Category without a help center — placed in the recovered folder
WARNINGS.MISSING_FILE_ASSET: The legacy file asset is missing — imported without its file
WARNINGS.EXTERNAL_URL_REFERENCE: Points at an external URL rather than a stored file
WARNINGS.HTML_CONVERSION_DEGRADED: Some HTML formatting could not be converted
WARNINGS.UNRESOLVED_EMPLOYEE: The legacy author could not be matched to an employee

ERROR_CODES.DB_WRITE_FAILED: The document could not be written
ERROR_CODES.PARENT_UNRESOLVED: The parent folder could not be resolved
ERROR_CODES.BINARY_COPY_FAILED: The file could not be attached

ROLLBACK.TITLE: Roll back migration
ROLLBACK.CONFIRM: Remove the documents created by this migration run?
ROLLBACK.EXPLAIN: This soft-deletes only the documents the migration created — they stay recoverable. The legacy Organization Documents and Help Center records are never touched. Migrated documents edited since the import, and migrated folders holding documents the migration did not create, are kept.
ROLLBACK.NOTHING: Nothing to roll back — no imported documents were found.
